The THRU alias is an alphanumeric group item over the record's STORAGE WINDOW from data-name-2's first character to data-name-3's last: the span parts are the record's NON-redefining leaves that intersect the window (a REDEFINES view adds no storage; a redefining FROM / THRU maps to the area it overlays; a boundary inside a leaf is a partial part rendered as the leaf's ref-mod view). ReferenceResolver.SpanLeafPlace makes every cell its storage image (NumericImagePlace for a numeric leaf, the new NationalBytesPlace - UTF-16BE pairs, D-N1 - for a usage-national leaf) and a partial part is a RefModPlace over that image in bytes, so a REDEFINES view of another layout that leaves an INTERIOR byte only half a national character covers (PB2466), or puts a window boundary on the odd byte of one (PB1902), is tiled and addressed like any other byte instead of drawing COBOL1655.
